name: Tom su nuong
summary: Tiger prawn, grilled, in the meal Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu ate at the night market. You choose the seafood and the stall cooks it. A price for the prawns alone was not printed.
origin: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, 16 May 2025.
howToEat: Choose the prawns and have them grilled. The market opens at 17:00 and is busiest from 19:00 to 22:00.

One dinner that also included steamed swimming crab, lemongrass ốc hương, a seafood hotpot, and garlic tôm mũ ni was 1,200,000 đồng for five people. That figure is the dinner, not a prawn price. Check on arrival for a plate.
where: Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in front of the daily market. The yard has no roof.
seoTitle: Tom su nuong — grilled tiger prawn in Con Dao
seoDescription: Tôm sú nướng is grilled tiger prawn at the Côn Đảo night market, open from 17:00. A prawn price was not printed. Check on arrival.
